residual_compute_single.display_name: Compute a residual for one data point

easy.statement_latex: A regression line $$y = 5x + 5$$ models how pounds of feed depend on bags of feed bought. For one data point, the observed pounds of feed is $44$ pounds when $bags of feed bought = 7$. Compute the residual for this data point.
hints: A residual is $y_{\text{observed}} - y_{\text{predicted}}$, where the prediction comes from substituting $x$ into the regression line.
First compute the predicted value $y = 5x + 5$ at $x = 7$.
solution_steps_latex: Compute the predicted value: $\hat y = 5 \cdot 7 + 5 = 40$.
Subtract the prediction from the observed value: $44 - 40 = 4$.
The residual is $4$.

easy.statement_latex: A regression line $$y = 4x + 5$$ models how total word count depend on pages drafted. For one data point, the observed total word count is $26$ words when $pages drafted = 6$. Compute the residual for this data point.
hints: A residual is $y_{\text{observed}} - y_{\text{predicted}}$, where the prediction comes from substituting $x$ into the regression line.
First compute the predicted value $y = 4x + 5$ at $x = 6$.
solution_steps_latex: Compute the predicted value: $\hat y = 4 \cdot 6 + 5 = 29$.
